tensor_order.name: W_ih
tensor_order.description: LSTM input-to-hidden weights stacked as [i, f, g, o] gates (4 * 64 x 8)

tensor_order.name: W_hh
tensor_order.description: LSTM hidden-to-hidden weights stacked as [i, f, g, o] gates (4 * 64 x 64)

tensor_order.name: b_ih
tensor_order.description: LSTM combined gate bias stacked as [i, f, g, o] (4 * 64)

tensor_order.name: W_adv
tensor_order.description: Dueling action-advantage stream weights A(h, a) for a in 0..5

tensor_order.name: W_gain
tensor_order.description: Per-qubit LLR gain residual projection weights

tensor_order.name: b_gain
tensor_order.description: Per-qubit LLR gain residual projection bias

equations.lstm_gates: gates = W_ih @ x_norm + W_hh @ h_{t-1} + b_ih; i = sigmoid(gates[0:64]); f = sigmoid(gates[64:128]); g = tanh(gates[128:192]); o = sigmoid(gates[192:256])
equations.lstm_state: c_t = f * c_{t-1} + i * g; h_t = o * tanh(c_t)
equations.dueling_q: V = W_val @ h_t + b_val; A = W_adv @ h_t + b_adv; Q(h_t, a) = V + (A[a] - mean(A))
